description: Check small business lending coverage readiness in two independent stages: first compute whether a financial institution meets the CFPB Section 1071 origination threshold from caller-supplied origination counts and validate SBLAR records against caller-declared required fields (ART-475); then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). All origination counts, field lists, and SBLAR records are caller-supplied; findings are arithmetic findings, never coverage determinations. Federal only, not legal advice.
name: small-business-1071-readiness-check

steps.handoff: Computes Section 1071 coverage from caller-supplied origination counts and validates SBLAR records against a caller-declared required-field list
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Small Business 1071 Readiness Check
